maya: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: we keep seeing large blast radii after broad feature-flag ramps. Proposing a compact remediation checklist and clear owners. Please pick items.

maya: Proposed short list:
- Auto-rollback guard for stateless flags (thresholds + metadata flag rollback_safe)
- Minimal CI canary probe (1% probe for 5m before ramp)
- Per-flag blast KPI + dashboard for weekly tracking

liam: I can own Auto-rollback. Draft thresholds: 5xx increase > 2pp for 5m OR p95 > 2x baseline for 5m. Require rollback_safe=true to auto-trigger. ETA: 10 days.

nora: I'll take the CI canary probe. Plan: 1% probe for 5m, compare to rolling 30m baseline, fail -> hold and page. Will add a lightweight helm hook for the probe. ETA: 7 days.

sam: I'll own telemetry and the blast KPI. Will surface per-flag activation histograms, traffic split, and a weekly "avg impacted pct" KPI. ETA: 12 days.

maya: Nice. Two design notes: (1) default max_rollout_pct for prod -> 5% unless owner opts up, (2) auto-rollback OFF for stateful migrations. Add metadata fields: rollback_safe, owner, max_rollout_pct.

liam: noted. We'll log each automated rollback event with flag, scope, trigger, and pre/post sample rates for auditing.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5001 -> "Auto-rollback spec" (assignee: liam, due: 10d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5002 -> "CI canary probe implementation" (assignee: nora, due: 7d).
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5003 -> "Per-flag telemetry & blast KPI" (assignee: sam, due: 12d).

maya: Next steps: owners update tickets with blocking deps and PR list by EOD Tue. Quick sync Wed 10:00 in #eng-platform to triage blockers. If you need more time, call it out now.

nora: pinging infra for probe quota approvals.

sam: will add retention requirements for telemetry in the ticket.

maya: Goal: reduce median blast radius by 30% next quarter with these changes. Thanks all.
